name: What is the typical cost range for building a primary residence tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for building a primary residence tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a primary residence tiny home with Zen Tiny Homes can vary significantly based on size, design complexity, materials, and chosen features. Our projects typically range from $120,000 to $250,000. This estimate generally covers design, construction, and basic utility hookups. Factors like custom cabinetry, premium finishes, advanced energy systems, and site-specific preparation can influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our primary residence tiny homes typically cost between $120,000 and $250,000, depending on size, design, and features.
